title: Euler spectral detection and critical-value audit
formal_results: Finite spectral correction formula at every truncation order
Vandermonde determinant and fixed-argument moment separation
Genuine analytic synthetic counterexample to unrestricted root-simplicity inference
Exact moved quadratic-jet critical value and explicit norm-margin criterion
Summability and finite spectral escape of the actual infinite depleted Euler packets
formal_non_claims: Nonzero exact critical scalars in terminal129 or terminal161 families
Full infinite epsilon-resolvent identity with all derivative interchanges in new Lean code
A new family classification or increased coverage bound
mathematical_correction: Nonzero spectral data at a fixed point do not exclude a moving or fixed critical zero after summing epsilon-weighted corrections.
failures_and_repairs: Development import path shadowing: copied baseline outputs only for development; final replay outputs were fresh.
Field simplification / finite sum rewrite, matrix product notation, derivative coercion, and API/linter failures were repaired.
Unrestricted non-tangency inference is false; preserved an exact synthetic counterexample instead of promoting it.
